reason: All five FR-03 normative clauses map to real assertions: missing X-API-Key → 401+problem+json (test_fr03.py:138,149,161); invalid/revoked key → 401+problem+json (test_fr03.py:263,277); SHA-256 hashed storage, no plaintext, key_hash column (test_fr03.py:340,352,363,373); revoked_at non-null → invalid (test_fr03.py:263 covers the revoked-key scenario); plaintext emitted exactly once by CLI (test_fr03.py:574,583); /healthz reachable without auth (test_fr03.py:421). SPEC.md:103-107 anchor each clause.

gaps.message: The `hmac.compare_digest` (constant-time) half of FR-03's storage clause has no direct assertion that would fail if a non-constant-time comparison (e.g., `==`) were used. Only the SHA-256 storage shape is asserted (line 340, 352); the timing/comparison-side contract is exercised only indirectly via the storage hash.
